column1: # Screenshot Search - web korpusu manifesti (tools/capture-web-corpus.py girdisi)
# Sutunlar: id / url / topic / intent / sensitive / note   -- ayirici: TAB
# topic ve intent degerleri android/.../data/ScreenshotItem.kt icindeki enum'larla birebir ayni.
# topic  : RECIPE MOVIE SERIES NEWS POLITICS FINANCE PLACE PRODUCT SPORT GAME AI BOOK MUSIC VIDEO SOCIAL OTHER
# intent : GO TRY BUY READ_WATCH REMEMBER UNCLEAR
# sensitive: bu korpusta hepsi false. "sensitive-negatif" notlu satirlar finansal GORUNEN
#            ama gercekte herkese acik sayfalar; sensitive dedektorunun yanlis alarm testi.
# Butun URL'ler 2026-07-21'de HTTP 200 doner (tools ile toplu dogrulandi).
